title: SSC CGL Tier-I topic-drill pool (Batch 4) — 60 focused questions

pattern_baseline.notice_paragraph: 13.8 (Tier-I scheme and syllabus), 13.8.1 (bilingual except English Comprehension), 13.8.2 (negative marking)
pattern_baseline.target_year_note: The 2027 CGL notice was not available on 2026-11-08. This drill pool follows the latest verifiable official 2026 Tier-I syllabus and is labelled as a 2026-pattern baseline for 2027 preparation.

provenance.pyq_statement: Every question is original ExamEdge practice written to the official 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Nothing here is copied from, reconstructed from, or presented as an SSC previous-year paper, shift or answer key.
provenance.translation: Hindi text is an ExamEdge translation for study parity, not an official SSC translation. English Comprehension is English-only in the official paper; the Hindi text here is a study aid.
provenance.authoring_note: Batch 4 drill pool: short, single-concept items intended for 15–30 question micro drills. No DI or cloze sets, because drills must stay intact and topic-focused.

review.label: Practice drills • auto-checked • human review pending
review.publish_rule: Production publication requires a named human reviewer and the attestation flag. The import CLI keeps content in Draft by default and refuses to publish without --reviewer and --confirm-human-review.
known_limits: Automated checks verify structure, declared topic quotas, duplicates, option shape and recomputed quantitative answers. They do not replace subject-expert review.
No independent human review has been completed for this drill pool yet.
The 2027 notice is not available; the 2026 notice is the pattern baseline.

coverage_plan.purpose: 60 standalone questions spread across the Tier-I syllabus so learners can build 15–30 question single-topic drills in the existing Subject & Topic Practice screen.
coverage_plan.full_mocks: This pool is not a full mock and is not counted as one; the 100-question full mocks are Batches 1–4.
